sources.note: Company overview: founded 1999, behavioral health/IDD EHR vendor, 35K+ users, 400K+ lives. Timeline from billing software to AI-powered EHR platform. Describes Cx360 Enterprise, Cx360 Intelligence, Cx360 GO, and DSP Assist.

Pricing model (one-time deploy + monthly per-user), third-party integrations (Dr. First for e-prescribing, MedFusion for portal), HL7 connection fees, HISP/Direct messaging fees, lab/CPOE activation. Reveals modular add-on architecture.
Billing and RCM features: claims submission, claim scrubbing, authorization management, AR management, automated ledger/bill generation, client portal eCommerce/credit card payments.

Clinical features for mental health: assessments, screening, treatment planning, AI documentation, dashboards, decision support, risk stratification, revenue cycle management, client engagement portal, telehealth.

EHR technology platform overview: care management, scheduling, workflows, mobile, secure communication, organization management, reporting/analytics, compliance, clinical optimization, assessments/screening/treatment, dashboards, risk stratification.

Features for health groups: comprehensive assessments (medical, addiction, social, psychiatric history), evidence-based screening, progress notes linked to treatment goals, medication management, behavioral tracking, call tracking, compliance. Targets mental health, SUD, IDD, CCBHC, child/family services.

IDD-specific features: person-centered planning, preconfigured templates, task triggering, HL7 data exchange, EVV, audit-ready records, DSP Assist mobile tool, configurable alerts for deadlines/authorizations.

Child and family services features: family portals, trauma-informed communication, foster care management, casework operations, integrated assessments, Title IV-E/CAPTA/COA compliance, state child welfare standards, intake automation.

Cx360 GO mobile app: ambient documentation (AI captures conversations, creates case notes), symptom tracking, EVV, GPS/time stamping, mileage tracking, offline functionality. Claims 50% documentation time reduction.

Cx360 v7.5 update (2022): expanded dashboard templates, workflow engine improvements, built-in telehealth, medication administration/behavioral health screening forms, automated ledger/bill generation, risk assessment scoring, modernized UI.
Capterra listing for Cx360. Some users noted concerns about suitability for substance abuse charting; positives included easy client search. (Page returned 403, relied on search snippet.)

KLAS reviews: users praise ease of use and staff adaptation. Concerns about training availability and product update cadence. Some users noted improving support responsiveness. Billing capabilities positively reviewed.

CCBHC reporting expansion: standardized built-in reports auto-populated from clinical/operational workflows, state-specific CCBHC requirements, operational reports for access/availability, demographics, staffing/credentialing, supervision/license tracking, service delivery, state-mandated roster files.

CCBHC-specific features page: care coordination across designated collaborating organizations, shared access to treatment plans/progress notes/assessment results, coordinated scheduling, compliance tracking.
